slides.heading: What it is
paras: Fogleman's ln turns any 3D scene into hidden-line vector paths, and vpype makes those paths plotter-ready.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 2 of 9. The idea. What it is. Fogleman's ln turns any 3D scene into hidden-line vector paths, and vpype makes those paths plotter-ready. From @index.opensource · @elemental.math · @nateherkai.

slides.text: The bridge — ln does hidden-line removal on 3D scenes, vpype sorts paths and cuts pen-up travel
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 3 of 9. The claim being tested. The bridge — ln does hidden-line removal on 3D scenes, vpype sorts paths and cuts pen-up travel. via @index.opensource.

slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: A working plotter artist would treat line density as the real design variable: they would measure millimetres of ink per square centimetre per region, cap it so the paper does not buckle or the pen does not bleed through…

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: The pen plotter (AxiDraw via axicli or a GRBL machine via vpype-gcode) completes each A3 plot without hand-edited SVG, paper tear or bleed-through…
vpype stat reports pen-up length before and after the pinned pipeline for all 6 files…

The pen plotter (AxiDraw via axicli or a GRBL machine via vpype-gcode) completes each A3 plot without hand-edited SVG, paper tear or bleed-through… vpype stat reports pen-up length before and after the pinned pipeline for all 6 files…

slides.heading: Triangle mush: rips and scans render every triangle edge
paras: path count in the hundreds of thousands, gray blob in preview.
FeatureMesh with welding and a dihedral threshold, slice hatching for flat areas.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 8 of 9. Biggest failure mode. Triangle mush: rips and scans render every triangle edge. Tell: path count in the hundreds of thousands, gray blob in preview. Fix: FeatureMesh with welding and a dihedral threshold, slice hatching for flat areas.
